Task: furnish this empty bathroom (Turkish: BANYO) labelled 'Banyo' on the plan. Style brief: Modern minimal, polished concrete floor, charcoal and white, brass details, cool daylight.

Room (metres, X right, Y up):
{"room_id": "r_L1_banyo", "label": "Banyo", "room_type": "bathroom", "area_m2": 6.27, "polygon_m": [[6.05, 4.25], [7.95, 4.25], [7.95, 7.55], [6.05, 7.55]], "doors": [{"id": "d_L1_004", "center": [6.0, 5.9], "width": 0.8, "opens_into_this_room": true}], "windows": [{"id": "win_L1_006", "center": [7.0, 7.67], "width": 0.6, "sill_height": null}]}

Allowed types with their size options [width, depth]:
- washbasin: height 0.85 m, size options [0.5, 0.4], [0.6, 0.45], [0.8, 0.5] (usually against a wall)
- toilet: height 0.8 m, size options [0.36, 0.65], [0.4, 0.7], [0.45, 0.75] (usually against a wall)
- shower: height 2.0 m, size options [0.8, 0.8], [0.9, 0.9], [1.2, 0.9] (usually against a wall)
- bathtub: height 0.6 m, size options [1.5, 0.7], [1.7, 0.75], [1.8, 0.8] (usually against a wall)
- washing_machine: height 0.85 m, size options [0.55, 0.55], [0.6, 0.6], [0.7, 0.7] (usually against a wall)

Rules that are checked afterwards (pieces that fail are moved or removed):
- every footprint lies fully inside the room polygon; pieces do not overlap;
- keep 0.6 m free in front of beds, sofas, desks and wardrobes (front = the -Y side at rotation 0, rotated with the piece);
- keep a 0.9 m wide walkway from every door to every other door and window;
- keep the door swing free: a half circle with the door width as radius inside the room the door opens into, and 0.6 m in front of every door;
- within 0.3 m of a window nothing may be taller than the sill (sill_height null = 0.9 m assumed); beds, sofas and tables may stand under a window;
- a piece with against_wall true must touch a wall with its back edge (its +Y side at rotation 0): choose rotation_deg so the back faces the wall (0 = back to a wall on the +Y side, 90 = back to a wall on the -X side, 180 = back to a wall on the -Y side, 270 = back to a wall on the +X side) and set the centre half the depth away from the wall.

A good layout for this room type: washbasin, toilet and a shower or bathtub, each against a wall, the toilet not directly opposite the door.

Fields of the answer: pieces, a list (at most 12, the most important piece first) of objects with
- type: one of washbasin, toilet, shower, bathtub, washing_machine
- center: [x, y] of the footprint centre in metres, in the same frame as the room polygon
- rotation_deg: 0..360 counter-clockwise; at 0 the width runs along X and the front faces -Y
- size: [width, depth] in metres, exactly one of the size options of the type
- against_wall: true when the back edge touches a wall
- reason: one short sentence why the piece is there

Answer only with JSON.

pieces.reason: Shower placed against the back wall for modern minimal style.
Washbasin placed against the left wall for functional access.
Toilet placed against the right wall, not directly opposite the door.
